messages:
Nina (AE): Quick sync — GulliverLabs wants a short migration POC to drop their current vendor. main ask: accept their existing requests with minimal client changes.
Omar (Sales Eng): Key customer asks: adapter for existing endpoints, response parity baseline, migration pricing for overlap runs, and a short security checklist.
Tess (Solutions Eng): We can build a compatibility proxy that maps fields and normalizes prompts. need a sample request/response pair to check edge cases (stop tokens, streaming, multi-turn).
Nina (AE): they sent this example: ```json {
"id":"s-900",
"text":"Summarize latest weekly update",
"variant":"neo-lite",
"max":128
}```
Tess (Solutions Eng): Notes: differences we'll hit — tokenization, default stops, and role/system message handling. plan: normalization + optional reranker. propose evaluation set of 250 golden prompts to measure delta.
Ravi (Security): Security asks for POC: BYOK, dedicated staging, IP allowlist, and 14-day raw-prompt purge. Dedicated staging covers most items; BYOK adds a few days.
Omar (Sales Eng): Pricing: customer wants clarity on dual-run billing. recommend migration credits (e.g., first 150k tokens free for 30 days). finance-bot, can we auto-provision that credit?
finance-bot: please submit migration credit request form. approval typically 48-72 hours for standard amounts.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Tech estimate: small proxy + smoke curl by day 3, full harness and reranker in ~10 business days (1 senior eng + 1 backend).
Nina (AE): Action items: 1) request 250 prompt samples + vendor outputs 2) send migration credit proposal 3) Tess to deliver smoke adapter + curl by day 3 4) Ravi to share POC security checklist. I'll email them with a 2-week pilot proposal.
Omar (Sales Eng): I'll prepare the presales runbook and smoke-test steps. will warn customer we can't promise 100% identical outputs but will aim for >=85% similarity on priority prompts.
Tess (Solutions Eng): will push a prototype branch and README with normalization rules tonight.
Ravi (Security): will drop the BYOK steps and retention language here once drafted.
Nina (AE): thanks all — I'll update once we get sample prompts.
